# Generate e2e — TUI smoke success (default verify) — hrc / afh expansion.
# Destination under $GEN_ROOT (0700 custody-safe parent).

mkdir $GEN_ROOT/parent-tui
chmod 0700 $GEN_ROOT/parent-tui

exec foundry generate --spec fixtures/smoke-tui.toml --dest $GEN_ROOT/parent-tui/foundry-smoke-tui --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
stdout '"commit_outcome":"committed"'
stdout '"plan_sha256"'
stdout '"network_disclosure"'
stdout 'go-mod-tidy'
! stderr .
exists $GEN_ROOT/parent-tui/foundry-smoke-tui/go.mod
exists $GEN_ROOT/parent-tui/foundry-smoke-tui/internal/tui/app.go
exists $GEN_ROOT/parent-tui/foundry-smoke-tui/docs/ui-architecture.md
! exists $GEN_ROOT/parent-tui/foundry-smoke-tui/internal/tui/effects.go
! exists $GEN_ROOT/parent-tui/foundry-smoke-tui/internal/tui/messages.go
dump_digest stdout
